niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right choice depends on your goals (brand vs. performance), budget, geography, target audience, required inventory (premium publishers vs. programmatic), and whether you need creative, measurement, or full-service media buying.

To help you choose, here’s a practical approach plus agencies/platforms to consider.

1) Pick by objective
- Brand/reach/premium inventory: large global media agencies with strong TV/CTV practices (OMD, MediaCom/Wavemaker, Mindshare, Initiative, UM, Starcom/Zenith) or direct platform-managed partners such as Roku Marketing Solutions, Amazon Ads, or platform teams at Samsung/Vizio.
- Programmatic/targeted scale and performance: DSPs and agencies that specialize in programmatic CTV — The Trade Desk (used by many agencies), Magnite, and agencies with strong programmatic desks.
- Creative/interactive CTV: Innovid, VidMob, or agency creative teams that specialize in CTV rich media and dynamic creative.
- Measurement & attribution: partners/agencies that integrate verification and measurement (Samba TV, VideoAmp, DoubleVerify, Integral Ad Science, Comscore).

2) Well-regarded names to consider
- Global holding company media agencies (full-service CTV buying + planning): WPP (MediaCom, Wavemaker, Mindshare), Omnicom (OMD, PHD), Publicis (Zenith, Starcom), IPG (Initiative, UM), Dentsu (Carat, iProspect).
- Independent/boutique & specialist agencies: Horizon Media (noted for advanced TV), programmatic-specialist shops and performance agencies (many regional; good for midmarket advertisers).
- Platforms/adtech (for buying/managed services): The Trade Desk, Roku OneView, Amazon Ads, Google/YouTube/Google Ads, Magnite, SpotX (Magnite), and supply-side/platform partners.
- Creative/measurement vendors: Innovid, VidMob, DoubleVerify, IAS, VideoAmp, Samba TV.

3) How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Inventory access: premium publishers and device/platform coverage (Roku, Samsung, Vizio, Hulu, Pluto, FAST apps).
- Buying options: guaranteed direct buys, PMP, programmatic guaranteed, or open exchange.
- Targeting & data: use of first-/third-party data, addressable targeting, household/projected demographics.
- Measurement & verification: third-party viewability/fraud verification, cross-platform measurement and incrementality testing.
- Frequency capping, dayparting, reporting cadence, and API/data sharing.
- Creative capabilities: CTV-first creative, dynamic/ad personalization, interactive options.
- Case studies + KPI alignment with your goals and industry.

4) Next steps I recommend
- Tell me: your campaign objective (brand awareness, consideration, direct response), monthly or campaign budget, target geography, and whether you already use any platforms (The Trade Desk, Roku, Amazon, etc.). I can then recommend 2–4 agencies or platforms most likely to fit your needs and provide a sample RFP/questions to send them.

If you want, give me those details and I’ll shortlist specific agencies or managed-platform teams for your situation.
